# semaphore_ex_global_credential_grant (Data Source)

Reads a global Semaphore EX credential project grant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_global_credential_grant" "application" {
  credential_id = semaphore_ex_global_credential.deployment_token.id
  id            = semaphore_ex_global_credential_grant.application.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `operations` (Set of String)
- `project_id` (Number)
- `revision` (Number)
- `status` (String)
